title: Timeline Redis ACL excludes application keys
fault_primitive: recurring Redis default-user key-pattern ACL reconciliation by an unmanaged detached process

diagnosis.description: An unmanaged access-policy process in media-mongodb repeatedly restricts the home-timeline-redis default user to the key pattern ~timeline:*. The application uses numeric user-ID keys outside that pattern, so Redis rejects timeline operations with key-authorization errors. Home timeline requests return HTTP 500 although Redis and application pods remain Ready. The mounted Redis configuration is not the active source of this runtime restriction. Repairing the ACL alone is temporary because the policy process restores it.

incident_class: unfinished keyspace isolation rollout with a stale operational policy synchronizer
symptoms: Home timeline reads return HTTP 500 with Redis key-authorization errors. Application pods remain Running and Ready. Native service and frontend error logs surge while the Kubernetes specifications and mounted Redis configuration remain unchanged.
